verdict.rationale: The SKILL.md spec and CLI explicitly separate 'name and description' metadata that agents load at startup to decide relevance/activation (skills-cli-docs-3), and a runtime probe confirms `--list` surfaces each skill's name plus full trigger description before install, letting a developer preview behavior without committing (skills-cli-probe-rt-2). A spec validator (skills-ref validate) further reinforces that skills should conform to a documented format, though this doesn't guarantee every third-party skill actually writes clear, predictable trigger docs — one community comment even flags surprise at unexpected embedded instructions in a design skill (skills-cli-comm-6). Missing for 10: independent verification that all/most published skills consistently include clear 'when it activates' documentation (not just that the CLI *can* surface it), and no enforcement mechanism ensuring description quality across the ecosystem.
